propositions: Tier-1 must re-verify stored Pass-1 findings using candidate verifier prompts/questions against the standard-class Bedrock Sonnet model, comparing candidate answers to stored answers with agreement metrics (κ, raw) and per-question no-answer counts.

Tier-1 must compute distribution shift across three axes: impact's categorical severity-attributes/binary answers using their vocabulary directly as bins, and validity/priority as continuous scalars binned into 10 fixed equal-width [0.0,0.1) through [0.9,1.0] buckets, reporting per-bucket count deltas and total variation distance.

Tier-1 must sample deterministically with fixed seed across stratified strata (verdict, leaf/container, finding-count bucket, project overlay/store, impact_model_version), excluding rows not verified or whose provider_provenance.ran_model is not the current standard-class model.

Tier-1 must reserve via ledger.reserve(ledger.estimate('tier1', n)) before any verifier call and reject runs exceeding the allocation or whose result model id is not the standard-class model at diff time.

Tier-1 reproduction run (VerifierCandidate(prompt_path=None)) must byte-for-byte match production's finding_listing/verify_request_chunks input and be recorded as the Pass-2 noise floor alongside per-question agreement in labels and reports.

A CLI subcommand tier1 --candidate <path-or-omitted> --n N --seed --store --cache-dir --out-dir must execute the full replay, produce per-question agreement tables, distribution shift analysis, downstream Tier-0 metrics, and commissioning spend not exceeding $40.
